value.rationale: The all-rank mixed-signal covariance problem is a separate, natural positive-semidefinite linear tomography target. The theorem classifies the minimal derivative order for uniform exact reconstruction across the entire cone, the full kernel dimension at every lower order, and explicit full-rank positive counterexamples; it is not simply a pure-signal corollary and applies uniformly in arbitrary degree.
